# Staging orders, 2026-11-26

`orders-staging-2026-11-26.json` is a verbatim pretty-print of the staging marketplace-service `GET /v1/orders` body captured on 2026-11-26 for James's test buyer `idgopdnhi9psboqguyzsmsj1hyyy7gks7wxa4ym9eazz6pibsfay` (seller `9kshs8g7cd33qr3jkg6hyu1nwayyrdp73qet3bi8yewncgbhcrxo`). Values are unchanged from that response. Order `470c02d8-9326-4d89-98f6-199df5a2ffcb` has `payment.review_reason` `upstream_inconsistent`.
